cells.gaps: No source found says one national switch connects wallets and bank accounts for every service. Kenswitch calls itself Kenya's domestic switch joining banks and mobile money providers; Pesalink reaches all banks, took in Airtel Money and began merchant payments in November 2026 (KEN-039, KEN-040), but M-PESA and payments to government are not shown on it.
cells.note: Rebuild: banks, wallets and telcos interoperate through Pesalink and Kenswitch, so 4. Two switches share the traffic and no source shows either serving every service, so not 5 (Bill, 2026-11-09, message 110); Pesalink's November 2026 merchant launch does not show it either.
